items.title: Live: RBA hikes interest rates to 4.35pc in third rate rise for 2026
items.description: The RBA has delivered another rate rise while the local share market is lower amid escalating tension in the Middle East. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Firefighter threatened to 'skin' Jewish paramedic, royal commission told
items.description: Paramedic Joshua Gomperts tells the royal commission into antisemitism how a firefighter pulled a hunting knife on him during a music festival in regional Victoria.

items.title: 'I have lost basically everything': Ex-AFL player opens up on compensation fight

items.title: Live: Iranian media rejects US claim of attack on IRGC speedboats

items.title: Jasper Jones author Craig Silvey pleads guilty to child exploitation material charges
items.description: Author Craig Silvey, best known for his books Jasper Jones and Runt, pleads guilty to distributing and possessing child exploitation material.

items.title: One-off tax cut in play as Albanese keeps budget options open

items.title: Victoria spruiks 'disciplined' budget despite cost-of-living handouts

items.title: Who are the winners and losers in Victoria's budget?

items.title: Meteor shower, a comet and the Moon: What's in the sky tonight

items.title: 'Not my state': Pauline Hanson promises hands-off approach as SA parliament resumes

items.title: Met gala red carpet: How the stars interpreted 'fashion is art' dress code

items.title: I don't care if I confuse people. Being 'wasian' is who I am

items.title: Search suspended for missing Australian hiker in Canada

items.title: Cadbury development to be of 'international significance': Mayor

items.title: Woman, 60, dies in crash as driver in allegedly stolen car flees scene
